description: Magazine changelog — oversized latest version plus past-release card grid.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { PlusIcon, RefreshCwIcon, Trash2Icon, WrenchIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" type ChangeType = "added" | "changed" | "fixed" | "removed" type ChangeItem = { type: ChangeType; text: string } type Release = { version: string date: string title: string description: string changes: ChangeItem[] latest?: boolean } const RELEASES: Release[] = [ { version: "1.3.0", date: "March 20, 2026", title: "Error Pages and Blog Components", description: "New error pages, blog UI blocks, and accessibility polish across the catalog.", latest: true, changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Error 500 / 403 / Maintenance examples" }, { type: "added", text: "Newsletter, filters, comments, changelog" }, { type: "changed", text: "Error 404 category move" }, { type: "fixed", text: "Icon a11y and mobile filter wrap" }, ], }, { version: "1.2.0", date: "March 1, 2026", title: "Calendar and Tree", description: "Keyboard-first data display primitives.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Calendar selection modes" }, { type: "added", text: "Tree multi-select" }, { type: "fixed", text: "Select edge positioning" }, ], }, { version: "1.1.0", date: "February 10, 2026", title: "Data Table and Timeline", description: "Sorting, pagination, and activity feeds.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Data table + timeline" }, { type: "removed", text: "SimpleTable deprecated" }, { type: "changed", text: "Sticky table headers" }, ], }, { version: "1.0.0", date: "January 15, 2026", title: "Initial Release", description: "Stable primitives, theming, and installable blocks.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Core UI + Tailwind v4" }, { type: "added", text: "Theme presets in oklch" }, ], }, ] function countByType(changes: ChangeItem[], type: ChangeType) { return changes.filter((c) => c.type === type).length } const COUNT_PILLS: { type: ChangeType label: string className: string icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; "aria-hidden"?: boolean }> }[] = [ { type: "added", label: "Added", className: "border-transparent bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", icon: PlusIcon, }, { type: "changed", label: "Changed", className: "border-transparent bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300", icon: RefreshCwIcon, }, { type: "fixed", label: "Fixed", className: "border-transparent bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300", icon: WrenchIcon, }, { type: "removed", label: "Removed", className: "border-transparent bg-destructive/10 text-destructive", icon: Trash2Icon, }, ] export default function Changelog({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const latest = RELEASES.find((r) => r.latest) ?? RELEASES[0] const older = RELEASES.filter((r) => r !== latest) return (

Changelog

Shipping notes

Magazine-style release highlights with past versions in a card grid.

Latest {latest.date}

{latest.version}

{latest.title}

{latest.description}

{COUNT_PILLS.map((pill) => { const n = countByType(latest.changes, pill.type) if (n === 0) return null const Icon = pill.icon return ( {n} {pill.label} ) })}
